nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set in constructor from msg.sender and used by onlyOwner.
Pending owner address used in the two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string, set once in the CRYPTOZOLToken constructor.
Token name string, set once in the CRYPTOZOLToken constructor.
Token decimals, set once in the CRYPTOZOLToken constructor.
Total token supply, set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
Nested allowance mapping, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom and read by allowance.
SafeMath addition helper with overflow require; called by transfer and transferFrom.
SafeMath subtraction helper with underflow require; called by transfer and transferFrom.
SafeMath multiplication helper with overflow check.
SafeMath division helper with divide-by-zero require.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function setting the pending newOwner address.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor initializing metadata and minting the full supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to', using safeSub and safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender then executes an external receiveApproval callback on the spender contract.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership checks and callback arguments.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state writes in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) from transferAnyERC20Token with an attacker-chosen token address.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().
